summary: Order placement 500s are caused by deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, deployed 12:10:00Z, 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders'). The new MarginCheckValidator dereferences a null marginProfile for orderType=FNO orders, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500. Errors start at 12:12:31Z (~2 min after rollout) and lift error_rate from ~0.2% to ~18.5%, sustained through the latest data. All competing causes are ruled out: no order-service config change, flat CPU/memory/latency/db-pool, flat request rate, and a clean downstream dependency (pricing-engine at 0.2% errors with no error logs). Recommendation: roll back dep-5101 or hotfix the null handling in MarginCheckValidator.

ranked_hypotheses.title: bad_deployment: order-service v2.14.0 MarginCheckValidator dereferences a null marginProfile for F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Deploy dep-5101 (v2.14.0) introduced a new MarginCheckValidator intended to check margin for F&O orders. It dereferences a marginProfile object that is null (or a value that must be explicitly loaded) for FNO orders, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and causing HTTP 500 rejections. The legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() that previously handled this path was removed, so the new code is now on the hot path for every F&O order.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 (v2.14.0) adds MarginCheckValidator and removes legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()
rollout completes 12:10:08; first NPE 12:12:31 (~2 min later)
new validator dereferences null marginProfile for orderType=FNO -> NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88
exception propagates to POST /v1/orders as HTTP 500, lifting error_rate to ~18%

assumptions: marginProfile is expected to be non-null for valid FNO orders in the normal flow (i.e. this is a code defect, not intentional validation)
no upstream data problem is suppressing marginProfile — supported by clean dependency telemetry (F10) but not proven at the data layer

ranked_hypotheses.title: data_issue: margin profile records missing/not populated upstream
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Margin profile records (in ledger-db or an upstream margin service) are missing or null for many FNO accounts, so a correctly-written validator receives null marginProfile and fails.

causal_chain.claim: margin profile source returns null for FNO accounts

ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: The failure begins within ~2 minutes of dep-5101 rollout and is deterministic across virtually every FNO account (F12) rather than a specific bad-data subset; dependency telemetry (pricing-engine) is clean (F10) and order-service db_pool connections are normal (F7), leaving no evidence of missing upstream data. A sudden simultaneous null across all accounts is far better explained by new code than by mass data loss with no other symptoms.

ranked_hypotheses.title: config_change or resource/capacity saturation on order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A config/feature-flag change or resource exhaustion (pool/CPU/memory) on order-service caused the failures.

causal_chain.claim: a config or resource change degrades order-service

ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: No config changes on order-service (F9); db_pool_in_use (F7), cpu_pct (F8) and request_rate are flat, latency is unchanged (F6), and the failures carry an application NPE rather than timeout/pool-exhaustion messages — inconsistent with resource or capacity saturation.

facts.statement: order-service error_rate rose from ~0.2% to ~18.3% between 12:00 and 12:12 buckets and remained ~18-20% through 13:48.
First order-service ERROR is a NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) for orderType=FNO at 12:12:31Z.
224 NPE events in MarginCheckValidator and 202 'order rejected with 500 ... marginProfile is null' events dominate.
Deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0) went out at 12:10:00Z, adding MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin; never rolled back.
order-service logged rollout complete for dep-5101 at 12:10:08Z, then first NPE at 12:12:31Z.
order-service latency_p99 was flat ~150ms, db_pool_in_use flat ~14 connections, cpu_pct flat ~40%, request_rate flat ~232 req/s throughout the incident.
No config changes occurred on order-service in the window; the only config change was on notification-service (email.batch_size).
Downstream dependency pricing-engine stayed at ~0.22% error_rate with zero WARN/ERROR logs in the window.
All failing orders are orderType=FNO, and failures span many distinct accounts (99733, 10578, 79537, ...).

assumptions: marginProfile is expected to be non-null for a valid FNO order in the normal flow, so the NPE is a code defect rather than intended validation.
The v2.14.0 rollout to all pods occurred at 12:10:08Z; there was no canary/paused rollout that would explain a late-arriving failure.
No margin-profile data-layer telemetry was directly available; the data_issue alternative is rejected on indirect evidence (clean dependency telemetry, determinism, timing).

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service to the pre-v2.14.0 version (revert dep-5101) to immediately restore F&O order placement.
recommended_actions.rationale: The fault was introduced by dep-5101 which is deployed and live; errors began ~2 min after rollout and are scoped exactly to the new F&O margin check.

recommended_actions.action: Hotfix MarginCheckValidator to null-guard / correctly resolve marginProfile for FNO orders before re-deploying the refactor.
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE is at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 on a null marginProfile; a null check plus correct profile loading must land before v2.14.0 is retried.

recommended_actions.action: Add a pre-deploy unit/integration test covering F&O order validation paths with missing-optional margin data.
recommended_actions.rationale: The regression escaped to production because the new validator was not exercised against null/absent margin profiles for FNO orders.

recommended_actions.action: Add canary/progressive rollout with error-rate auto-abort for order-service so a validator regression is caught before full rollout.
recommended_actions.rationale: Full rollout at 12:10 followed by 18% error rate at 12:12 could have been caught and auto-reverted earlier.

findings.statement: Deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0) was deployed at 12:10:00 with summary 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders', adding a new MarginCheckValidator and removing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(); status live, never rolled back.
order-service logged 'deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) rollout complete, all pods ready' at 12:10:08, then the first NPE at 12:12:31 — errors began ~2 minutes after rollout completed.

findings.statement: latency_p99_ms was flat at ~150ms across the whole window, including after 12:12 (e.g. 151.86 at 12:12, 147.54 at 12:36).
db_pool_in_use stayed flat at ~14 connections (max 15.24) throughout, showing no connection-pool exhaustion.
cpu_pct stayed flat at ~40% and request_rate flat at ~232 req/s across the window — no load spike or CPU saturation.

Downstream dependency pricing-engine error_rate stayed flat at ~0.22% with zero WARN/ERROR logs in the window; no dependency-side errors.
Errors are scope-limited to orderType=FNO (derivatives) orders; only FNO orders produce the NPE, consistent with a new margin check gated to F&O orders.
